registry_mentions.quote: Natural History Study: In 2006, the Greenwood Genetic Center in South Carolina, USA began the first ever Natural History Study for Mucolipidosis.
ISMRD subsequently partnered with the lead investigator Dr Sara Cathey and the Greenwood Genetic Center to extend the Natural History Study to the other eight diseases that ISMRD supports.
We were notified shortly after that they had found a 10/10 match for Kate through the Be the Match registry.
